newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Stals says budget to help rate cut - paper.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Stals says budget to help rate cut - paper.

text.p: Finance Minister Trevor Manuel's restrictive budget for 1997/1998 would make it easier to cut interest rates later this year, Reserve Bank governor Chris Stals said.
In an interview with Business Day, Stals said the budget would make his job easier, and also gave more details on the practical implications of easing foreign exchange controls on individuals.

He was upbeat on the prospects for the balance of payments in the face of the easing of controls, predicting that capital inflows from foreign investors would be enough to cover the outflows resulting from reforms.
Stals said one of the ways in which the budget would make his job easier was through its positive effect on perceptions in the markets.
But it would also help in the fight against inflation, he said.
